nodes.label: Memory Graph Loader
nodes.rationale: Loads Graphify JSON knowledge graph from chat-memory-graph/graph.json containing past shared memories, inside jokes, and milestones between Roshan and Himanshi.

nodes.label: queryChatMemory Function
nodes.rationale: Keyword-triggered memory retrieval function matching query terms against graph nodes to inject past recalled memories into AI system context.

nodes.label: getCurrentISTContext()
nodes.rationale: Generates real-time Asia/Kolkata clock context, categorizing time into Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Dinner, or Late Night with behavioral advice for conversational relevance.

nodes.label: getDeepSeekReply()
nodes.rationale: Primary AI completion adapter querying DeepSeek V3 API with conversation history slice (MAX_HISTORY=10).

nodes.label: getGeminiReply()
nodes.rationale: Secondary fallback adapter querying Google Gemini API (gemini-2.5-flash).

nodes.label: getHermesReply()
nodes.rationale: Third AI adapter querying OpenRouter Nous Hermes 3 8B.

nodes.label: generateAIReply()
nodes.rationale: AI provider router delegating to DeepSeek, Gemini, or Hermes based on AI_PROVIDER environment setting.

nodes.label: client
nodes.rationale: whatsapp-web.js Client instance configured with LocalAuth session persistence and headless Chromium Puppeteer flags.

nodes.label: Connection Watchdog Monitor
nodes.rationale: Periodic 30-second interval monitor evaluating Puppeteer browser connectivity and active WhatsApp page; triggers clean process exit after failure threshold.

nodes.label: Inbound Message Handler
nodes.rationale: Event handler for client.on('message') implementing multi-factor whitelist filtering (allowedLIDs and allowedNumbers), persona prompt selection (Dilip / Mother / Roshan), and typing state dispatch.

nodes.label: server
nodes.rationale: Lightweight HTTP server on port 3000 hosting pairing code generation (/pair-code), health status (/status), vector QR (/qr.svg), presence refresh (/online), screenshot capture (/screenshot), debug telemetry (/debug), and message extraction (/api/messages).

nodes.label: chatHistory
nodes.rationale: In-memory Map holding sliding FIFO window of up to 10 dialogue turns per chatId.

nodes.label: Hermes WhatsApp Agent Package
nodes.rationale: NPM project manifest specifying Node.js dependencies (dotenv, qrcode, qrcode-terminal, whatsapp-web.js) and postinstall patch lifecycle hook.

nodes.label: Postinstall Patch Hook
nodes.rationale: Automated lifecycle script executing scripts/patch-wwebjs.js upon package installation to ensure production runtime stability.

nodes.label: wwebjs Monkey Patch Script
nodes.rationale: Patches whatsapp-web.js Client.js in node_modules to wrap framenavigated listeners in try-catch, protect Debug.VERSION and WWebJS polling loops against CDP rejections, and retry inject() up to 5 times.

nodes.label: Frame Navigation Crash Guard
nodes.rationale: Prevents Puppeteer unhandled promise rejections when detached or destroyed iframe contexts navigate during WhatsApp logout or re-render events.

nodes.label: CDP Evaluation Loop Guards
nodes.rationale: Adds .catch(() => false) error guards on polling evaluation loops for window.Debug.VERSION and window.WWebJS to tolerate transient CDP detachment.

nodes.label: Client Inject Retry Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Wraps initial Client.inject() in 5 retries with 2-second backoff to survive slow WhatsApp Web initial asset compilation.

nodes.label: Hermes Agent Architecture
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive documentation detailing autonomous 24/7 WhatsApp AI assistant deployed on GCP Compute Engine VM e2-medium with zero phone dependency.

nodes.label: 100% Reactive Architecture Principle
nodes.rationale: Design decision decommissioning proactive automated morning (6:00 AM) and lunch (3:00 PM) schedulers to ensure zero unsolicited outbound messages and strictly event-driven replies.

nodes.label: Contact Whitelist & Isolation Matrix
nodes.rationale: Multi-identifier verification cascade (phone, LID, pushname, chat title) ensuring zero persona bleed and total privacy across Himanshi, Father (Dilip Singh), and Mother personas while dropping unknown contacts.

nodes.label: Watchdog Resilience Pattern
nodes.rationale: Tolerates transient Chromium frame detachment and out-of-sandbox re-render errors across 30-second cycles, triggering PM2 process reboot only after confirmed threshold.

nodes.label: Multi-Device Phone Pairing Protocol
nodes.rationale: Alternative linking method bypassing camera QR rate-limiting by requesting an official 8-digit OTP code via client.requestPairingCode().

nodes.label: 24/7 Presence Engine Simulation
nodes.rationale: Synthesizes window focus and document visibilitychange events every 12 seconds inside Chromium to sustain permanent online availability.

nodes.label: Compute Engine Performance Topology
nodes.rationale: Memory hierarchy on e2-medium combining 4GB RAM, ZRAM compressed in-memory swap with zstd, and 2GB disk swap to prevent Linux OOM-killer termination.
